generatedProse.concept-context: In the School of Sport, rigour is judged across the whole arc of a project. Examiners look for a clear line from the research questions, through a method the ethics committee approved, to the analysis the dissertation reports. This holds whether the evidence is lab data, training records, participation figures or clinical outcomes. A sport dissertation is where this coherence is tested most searchingly, because it draws together design, ethics, data handling and reporting on a larger scale than any earlier assignment.
generatedProse.worked-example:
Two sport therapy and rehabilitation students reach the final weeks of the same dissertation on recovery after ankle injury.

Tom treated each stage as a separate box to tick. The proposal promised a controlled trial of a rehabilitation protocol, the data was gathered instead from whichever clinic patients happened to attend, and the ethics approval no longer matches what happened. The write-up is polished, but the gaps between what was proposed, approved and done are visible to any careful reader.

Amara kept the thread intact. The questions set in her proposal, the protocol approved by the ethics committee, and the outcome analysis reported in her dissertation all line up, and every departure, such as a smaller sample than planned, is explained with reasons. The work can be defended at each step because its integrity was sustained throughout, not assembled at the end.

Both submitted a dissertation. Only Amara could show that rigour held from proposal to submission, which is what the sport dissertation, as the ultimate test of these competencies, is built to reveal.
generatedProse.summary: Rigour in the School of Sport is not a stage but a thread that runs from proposal to dissertation, across every subject in the school. You can now articulate how integrity, transparency and accountability are sustained, evaluate whether a sport project holds together across its stages, and defend the decisions that keep research rigorous. The dissertation is where that sustained integrity is finally tested.

check.body: What is the clearest sign that a sport therapy dissertation has upheld rigour from proposal to submission?

items.text: The questions, methods and findings line up across the stages, and any departure from the plan is explained with reasons.
The dissertation is longer than the proposal required.
The proposal and the dissertation describe completely different studies.
No one was able to question the rehabilitation protocol used.

feedback.correct: That's right. Rigour shows as coherence across the stages, with any departure explained.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. What links the proposal, the method and the findings?
feedback.incorrectFinal: Rigour shows when the questions, methods and findings line up and changes are explained; length, divergence or avoiding scrutiny do not show it.
